svg.title: Sollis Health PATHFAST hs-TnI 0/1-hour chest pain pathway
svg.desc: Clinical pathway with connected arrows from the initial blood draw and ECG to baseline troponin ranges, initial disposition or timed serial testing, followed by four provider-assessed dispositions.
svg.text: H E A L T H
0/1-hour standard pathway · Clinical decision support for provider review

Follow the approved assay-specific protocol; verify thresholds with medical leadership. Troponin alone does not diagnose MI.
